name: The Last Listener
subtitle: A signal of life in a world gone quiet
description: Half-buried in a vast, dark salt plain, an old shortwave radio still holds a faint amber glow. From the center of its weathered speaker grille, a small green shoot rises into the last light of day. The work sets the fragile persistence of life against the silence of abandonment: even when no voice answers, something may still begin again.
